headline: Writer and former Bangla Academy president Abul Kashem Fazlul Haq passes away at 85
summary: The prominent academic and writer died at the National Heart Foundation today due to age-related complications.
details: Prominent writer and academic Abul Kashem Fazlul Haq has passed away today at the age of 85. He breathed his last around 3:30 pm at the National Heart Foundation.
According to his son-in-law Anwar Ul Hasan, the professor suddenly fell ill during a family gathering and was rushed to the hospital, where he was declared dead.
Abul Kashem was a former professor of Bangla language and literature at Dhaka University and served as the president of the Bangla Academy.
He was widely recognized for his extensive contributions to literature, research, and academia over several decades.
He was the father of Faisal Arefin Dipan, the owner of Jagriti Prokashony, who was killed in 2015 by members of the banned Ansarullah Bangla Team.
caption:
A giant of Bangla literature and academia has left us. Abul Kashem Fazlul Haq, former Bangla Academy president, has passed away at 85.

Prominent writer and academic Abul Kashem Fazlul Haq has passed away today at the age of 85. He breathed his last around 3:30 pm at the National Heart Foundation.

According to his son-in-law Anwar Ul Hasan, the professor suddenly fell ill during a family gathering and was rushed to the hospital, where he was declared dead.

Abul Kashem was a former professor of Bangla language and literature at Dhaka University and served as the president of the Bangla Academy.

He was widely recognized for his extensive contributions to literature, research, and academia over several decades.

He was the father of Faisal Arefin Dipan, the owner of Jagriti Prokashony, who was killed in 2015 by members of the banned Ansarullah Bangla Team.

#Bangladesh #Literature #BanglaAcademy #DhakaUniversity #Obituary

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: Actress Rupali's harassment case: Suspect arrested
summary: Police have arrested a person accused of harassing actress Rupali
details: Police have arrested a suspect in connection with the allegations of harassment brought forward by actress Rupali.
The arrest follows a formal complaint filed by the actress regarding the harassment she faced.
Authorities are continuing their investigation into the matter to determine the full extent of the charges.
The suspect remains in custody as legal proceedings move forward.
caption:
